fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private seller on Marketplace.
findings: Hazy, yellowed headlight lenses on the front corners
Dull, flat-looking silver paint on the tailgate and bed sides
Faded gray rear bumper and lower trim cladding
Light dust and grime on the lower doors and wheel arches
Dirty wheels with brake dust on the spokes
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the F-150 FX4. The headlights look a bit hazy and the rear bumper and lower trim have faded, which a pre-sale detail with headlight and trim restoration would freshen up. We come to you, so there's no need to drop the truck off. Would you like a quote?
